title: Bars for the Display Hall
request: Hang a bar of loans for every wing in the Display Hall, busiest wing first, and hand me the ordered table you charted so the sign painter can copy it.
objective: Draw a horizontal bar chart of a categorical column and deliver the ordered table behind it.
hints: The painter copies the table, so the table itself has to carry the order the wall shows.
barh takes the category column first and the measured column second; sort has a descending flag.
Sort the two-column hall table by loans downward, chart that sorted table, and deliver the very same table.
inputCode:
import random
from datascience import Table, make_array
wings = ['Reference', 'Nature', 'Travel', 'Poetry', 'Mystery', 'Science', 'Letters']
n = random.randint(3, 6)
picked = random.sample(wings, n)
loans = random.sample(range(5, 90), n)
shelf = Table().with_columns('wing', make_array(*picked), 'loans', make_array(*loans))
